faq.q: Can foreigners buy land in Halkidiki?
faq.a: Yes. EU citizens buy on the same terms as Greeks, and non-EU buyers can also buy, although some border areas of Greece need extra approval. Your lawyer checks whether this applies to the plot you choose. As of November 2026, you need a Greek tax number and bank account in every case.

faq.q: Can I build a house on land I buy in Halkidiki?
faq.a: Often, but not always. Whether you can build, and how much, depends on the zoning, the plot size, road access and any forest or archaeological restrictions. Ask a civil engineer to check the plot and give you a written answer before you sign anything.

faq.q: How much does a plot of land cost in Halkidiki?
faq.a: Land prices depend mainly on location, sea view, distance to the beach, size and buildability. A buildable sea-view plot near a popular resort costs far more than an olive grove inland. Use the price filter to see current plots, and ask us about each one.

faq.q: What is the minimum plot size to build outside a village in Greece?
faq.a: As a general rule, building outside a town plan has required a plot of about 4,000 m² with access to a public road, with exceptions for some older plots. These rules have changed in recent years and keep evolving, so as of November 2026 an engineer and your lawyer must confirm each plot.

body:
Building plots for sale in Halkidiki

Plots inside a village or town plan are usually the simplest to build on, with roads and utilities nearby. Larger plots outside the plan give more space and privacy, but the rules are stricter.

Beachfront and sea-view land

Beachfront land is rare and in demand. The shore in Greece is public, and building is restricted in the zone next to it. Hillside plots with a sea view are more common and often more practical.

Land inside or outside the village plan

Inside the plan, building terms are set for each area. Outside the plan, buildability depends on the plot size, road access and zoning, and these rules have changed several times in recent years. As of November 2026, to be confirmed by our lawyer, every plot must be checked one by one.

Can I build on this plot?

Only a civil engineer can answer this for a specific plot, after checking the zoning, the size, the road frontage, any forest or archaeological restrictions and the utility connections. Get this answer in writing before you sign.

Buying land in Greece as a foreigner

EU and non-EU buyers can buy land in Greece with a Greek tax number (AFM) and a Greek bank account. Some border areas need extra approval for non-EU buyers, to be confirmed by our lawyer. See our buying guide for the full process.
